title: form_classification
description: Where a form is filed — one row per (form_key x steward_org x context x sub_context x population). Same flat shape and wildcard rule as cde_classification. A form is an assembly instrument and is NOT recommendation-tiered, so there is deliberately NO `tier` column here. These scoping columns are what a member's classification is matched against to resolve the member's tier ON the form (wildcards match anything; most-specific member row wins).

form_key.description: The classified form's key (matches form.form_key; also the CLASSIFIES relationship target). Part of the identity.

steward_org.description: The classifying authority. Part of the identity.

context.description: Top scope: disease / study / collection the form is filed under. Part of the identity. '*' = all.

sub_context.description: Second scope: scenario / severity / phase. Part of the identity. '*' = the whole context.

population.description: Applicability scope: population. Part of the identity. '*' = all populations.

domain.description: Descriptive top-level Domain (display column, not identity). Null when absent.
